citations.quote:
[name="西尔弗"]伊西多先生，你深夜出现在坟墓，盗取本镇居民尸体的事属实吗？
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[Background(image="57_g13_ibtown_d",xScale=1.5, yScale=1.5, fadetime=1,screenadapt="coverall")]
[curtain(direction = 2,fillfrom = 0.01,fillto = 0.5, fadetime=1)]
[curtain(direction = 6,fillfrom = 0.01,fillto = 0.2, fadetime=1)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_293_thorns_1#1$1",duration=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4163_rosesa_1#19$1",duration=1.5)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[name="伊西多"]我不否认出现在墓地，但我……
[Dialog]
[stopmusic(fadetime=2)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_293_thorns_1#1$1",focus="none")]
[CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=10, ystrength=10, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="？？？"]什么？！
[Dialog]
[curtain(direction = 2,fillfrom = 0.5,fillto = 0.18, fadetime=1)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_293_thorns_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="伊西多"]帕斯卡拉小姐？
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4163_rosesa_1#19$1",focus="r")]
[name="帕斯卡拉"]伊西多老兄，想不到你居然是这种人，偷什么不好你去偷尸体？
[name="帕斯卡拉"]有点恶心了哦。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_293_thorns_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="伊西多"]容我提醒，你的脖子上也戴着枷锁，帕斯卡拉小姐。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_293_thorns_1#1$1",focus="none")]
[name="习武教士"]安静些！下一个审的就是你！
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_293_thorns_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="伊西多"]那你为什么会出现在这里？
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4163_rosesa_1#3$1",focus="r")]
[name="帕斯卡拉"]我……唉，旧习难改。

contributions.description: 帕斯卡拉与伊西多均在西尔弗主持的刑场，西尔弗随后宣判两人。
